sobreMi: Systems Engineer with 4 years of experience, specializing in backend development and architecture modernization. Expert in migrating legacy systems (Oracle Forms) to modern .NET ecosystems, building robust APIs, and containerization with Docker. Focused on code quality (SonarQube) and observability (Serilog).

detalles: Comprehensive migration from .NET Framework 4.5 to .NET 6 (MVC and API).
SQL Server database design: views, functions, and stored procedures.
Implementation of advanced business logic using LINQ and Entity Framework.
Development of dynamic user interfaces with Razor on the Frontend.
Upgraded critical banking workflows using BPM Ultimus.
Designed API architectures in .NET 6 (C#) adhering to the layered pattern.
Migrated Web Services (VB) to modern services featuring Sybase integration.
Implemented Docker with Redis, Serilog, and SonarQube for code quality and caching.
Enhanced security through canonical signatures and monitoring via HealthChecks.
Migrated Oracle Forms to an MVC Web Application and Web Services (.NET 4.5).
Managed Oracle 11g database infrastructure (Packages, Stored Procedures).
Rebuilt complex reporting mechanisms from Oracle Reports to Reporting Services.

logros: Successfully modernized legacy banking and government enterprise systems.
Optimized workflows through automation leveraging AI models (Gemini/Llama).
Reduced technical debt by introducing SonarQube and Serilog into the development pipeline.

politicaPrivacidad.seccion1Texto: Our application uses Google Identity Services for authentication and the Google Calendar API exclusively to create the appointment event requested by you. We access basic profile information (your name and email). We do not access, read, or query your personal calendar events or availability; schedule availability is determined solely from our system's predefined agenda.
politicaPrivacidad.seccion2Titulo: 2. How We Use Google User Data
politicaPrivacidad.seccion2Texto: Google user data is accessed solely to validate your active session and insert the confirmed appointment directly requested by you. Strictly necessary cookies are used to keep your chat session secure. Your data is never used to train AI or Large Language Models (LLMs).
politicaPrivacidad.seccion3Texto: We do not sell, trade, rent, share, or transfer your Google user data to any third parties under any circumstances. All data operations remain strictly between your session, our secure assistant, and Google's official APIs.
politicaPrivacidad.seccion4Texto: We implement robust industry-standard security practices to protect your data. All data in transit is encrypted using Secure Sockets Layer (SSL/TLS / HTTPS) protocols. OAuth credentials and tokens are managed securely and never stored unencrypted.
politicaPrivacidad.seccion5Texto: We do not store permanent copies of your Google data on our servers. Access is maintained dynamically during your active session to complete the appointment creation. You can revoke our application's access at any time directly from your Google Account at
politicaPrivacidad.seccion6Texto: Our use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. Your Google user data is accessed solely to facilitate scheduling via the AI agent and is not used for training AI/LLM models, nor is it sold, shared, or transferred to third parties.
